questions.stem: The Gupta period is widely considered by historians as the 'Golden Age' of ancient India. Who was the historical founder of the Gupta dynasty?
questions.explanation: Sri Gupta founded the Gupta dynasty in the 3rd century CE. His son Ghatotkacha succeeded him. However, the first powerful, independent emperor who assumed the title Maharajadhiraja was his grandson, Chandragupta I.

questions.stem: Which great Gupta emperor is famous for his exceptional musical talents and is often depicted on his own gold coins actively playing the Veena (a stringed instrument)?
questions.explanation: Samudragupta, famously known as the 'Napoleon of India' for his vast conquests, was also a man of culture, a poet, and a musician. His 'Veena-playing' coin type confirms his love for music.

questions.explanation: Harishena was the court poet (Sandhivigrahika) of Samudragupta. He composed the Prayag Prashasti in classical Sanskrit. It is a vital historical document that lists all the kings and regions conquered by Samudragupta.

questions.stem: Which famous ancient Indian astronomer and mathematician, who lived during the Gupta period, was the first to explicitly claim that the earth rotates on its own axis and calculated the value of Pi (π) to four decimal places?
questions.explanation: Aryabhata, the author of Aryabhatiya, lived during the Gupta era. He correctly explained the scientific causes of solar and lunar eclipses, stated that the Earth rotates on its axis causing day and night, and gave a highly accurate approximation of Pi.
